purpose: Evaluation test cases and golden standard responses for MedBalance interactive district copilot

test_cases.golden_answer: Hesaraghatta Primary Health Centre (H4) did not receive Insulin Regular 100 IU/ml (INS-REG) because of Rule F3: the destination cold storage unit (DEV-ILR-H4) is currently offline and under repair.

test_cases.query: What if we repair its fridge?
test_cases.golden_answer: In the counterfactual simulation where cold storage at Hesaraghatta Primary Health Centre (H4) is repaired, 1 order is added to the plan transferring cold-chain stock to H4, reducing shortage by 10 units.

test_cases.query: Can you give me an overview of the district health network and active redistribution orders?
test_cases.golden_answer: The district network monitors 5 health facilities (Bengaluru District Hospital 1 (H1), Yelahanka Taluk Hospital (H2), Anekal Community Health Centre (H3), Hesaraghatta Primary Health Centre (H4), and Central District Warehouse (W0)). The cold chain status is OPERATIONAL.

test_cases.query: What is the stock position of Paracetamol 500mg at Yelahanka Taluk Hospital (H2)?
test_cases.golden_answer: At Yelahanka Taluk Hospital (H2), Paracetamol 500mg (PCM-500) has a stock on hand of 8000 units with a daily consumption rate of 2.0 units per day.

test_cases.query: Why was transfer order DTA/BLR-U/2026/000001 created?
test_cases.golden_answer: Transfer order DTA/BLR-U/2026/000001 reallocates 28 units of Insulin Regular 100 IU/ml (INS-REG) from Hesaraghatta Primary Health Centre (H4) to Bengaluru District Hospital 1 (H1) to avoid imminent expiration and reduce high-priority shortage.

test_cases.query: Is the cold chain network currently safe and operational?
test_cases.golden_answer: The district cold chain network is OPERATIONAL with 7 monitored devices and 0 active excursions. Note that DEV-ILR-H4 at Hesaraghatta Primary Health Centre (H4) remains OFFLINE pending compressor maintenance.

test_cases.query: Show me the cryptographic audit trail for order ORD-001.
test_cases.golden_answer: The audit trail for order ORD-001 contains 2 verified events: ORDER_CREATED by system:optimizer and ORDER_APPROVED by pharmacist:H1, protected by a tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chain.

test_cases.query: How does our QUBO allocation compare against the classical MILP exact optimum?
test_cases.golden_answer: The benchmark analysis demonstrates that the QUBO allocation achieves an exact 0.0% optimality gap compared to the classical MILP optimum, while eliminating all 18 units of wasted stock moved by manual greedy reallocation.

test_cases.query: What if route H1 to H2 is closed due to flash flooding?
test_cases.golden_answer: In the counterfactual simulation where route H1-H2 is closed, transit routes are redirected through alternative safe paths without increasing stockout penalties.

test_cases.query: Why didn't Anekal Community Health Centre (H3) get more ORS sachets?
test_cases.golden_answer: At Anekal Community Health Centre (H3), Oral Rehydration Salts 20.5g (ORS-20) has zero residual shortage because projected demand is satisfied by the current allocation plan.

test_cases.query: ಹೆಸರಘಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಇನ್ಸುಲಿನ್ ಏಕೆ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ?
test_cases.golden_answer: ಹೆಸರಘಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ (H4) ಇನ್ಸುಲಿನ್ (INS-REG) ನಿಯಮ F3 (Rule F3) ರ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಶೈತ್ಯಾಗಾರ (DEV-ILR-H4) ದುರಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

test_cases.query: What is the current stock and shortage of Insulin at Bengaluru District Hospital 1 (H1)?
test_cases.golden_answer: At Bengaluru District Hospital 1 (H1), Insulin Regular 100 IU/ml (INS-REG) has a daily consumption rate of 2.0 units per day with high clinical priority.
